Metadata: Ordered creator names as supplied by the source.
Language identifier as supplied; no normalization is imposed.
Publication date, preserving uncertain or partial dates.
External bibliographic identifier; distinct from domain identity.
Property: Textual descriptive value; structured analysis belongs in typed annotations.
Source: Opaque source locator; never fetched by this crate.
Source format label, such as tei or epub; extensible and not a parser registry.
Provenance: Namespaced derivation method, for example source:transcription or ai:inference.
Responsible person, software, or model and version.
Inputs from which this value was derived.
Reference: Target node, or the whole document.
Optional Unicode scalar range; requires a block node.
Block: Namespaced semantic role, such as text:paragraph or manuscript:line.
Canonical text to which byte offsets apply.
Section: Namespaced semantic role, such as bible:chapter or paper:section.
Document: Origin and transformations of this document.
CorpusDescriptor: Extensible manifest type, including text, web, parallel, speech, or docs.
Source corpus version; distinct from crate version.
InlineMarkup: Neutral semantic classification of source inline markup.
Source attributes with namespace-qualified keys; values are not resolved.
AnnotatedCorpus: Envelope version; supported version is ANNOTATED_CORPUS_VERSION.
Inline layer including its original provenance.
